modes.boundary: Provides diagnostic exposure and authored feedback only; does not prove productive design skill.
Requires shared case identity, ordered steps, carried state, per-step feedback, and case completion semantics.
The accessibility batch contains no requirements-owned slots.
Scores recognition of the constraint-grounded decision, not an authored tradeoff defense.
Eligibility requires prior committed incorrect evidence for the same item or slot; empty eligibility is unavailable.
Single-choice cannot assess original requirements discovery, architecture production, diagrams, or defense.
No provider/exam format is claimed; a choice quiz is not a design interview simulation.

selectionRules: select unique item IDs without replacement
remain track-local and node-local unless a future blueprint explicitly owns cross-node selection
use deterministic seeded ordering and persist option order per occurrence
never count a slot, binding, or repeated occurrence as an authored unique item
truthfully shorten to eligible unique item count or expose unavailable; never silently fill from another node or unresolved source pool
